programs.description: Satya slips into a coma after undergoing a face transplant after an accident where his face is damaged and his lover Deepthi dies. On waking up, he decides to avenge her death.
The grandson of a rich businessman promises to reunite him with his estranged daughter and enters their home in disguise. However, he has to deal with several challenges to keep his promise.
Angala Parameswari, an avatar of Goddess Parvati, wants to protect the people of Earth. Kaveri, her ardent follower, seeks her help when her life is in danger.
Dharma, a broken man drowning in despair, finds his world transformed when he rescues Charlie, an abused pup. Later, they embark on a journey of hope and redemption.
Madhava and Geetha's village romance ends abruptly when they part ways for college in different cities. However, Madhava finds solace and new love with Ithi, who helps mend his broken heart.
In the coastal village of Marlur, Ashoka's innocent crush sparks rumours of ghostly possession, creating comedic chaos and unexpected twists.
When greed paves the way for betrayal, scheming and murder, a young tribal reluctantly dons the traditions of his ancestors to seek justice.
Karthik, a romantic at heart, navigates the hardships and complications of life while attempting to find his perfect match.
Gurudev Hoysala, a morally upright police inspector, is transferred to Athani to investigate a fellow officer's disappearance. However, a suspicious young couple soon complicates the case.
A sportsman travelling to a village for a match saves a woman from a brutal factionist. The latter pursues them, but he refuses to back down from the confrontation, changing his life forever.

Ambi, a retired stunt master, sets out on a heartfelt journey to reconnect with his lost love, facing unexpected challenges and rediscovering his purpose along the way.
Brothers Raj and Shankar choose opposing paths after goons murder their father. Raj turns outlaw seeking vengeance, Shankar joins the police force.
Raja, a visually impaired young man, steps in to save Lucky from a gangster's deadly pursuit. Subsequently, touched by his unwavering courage and kindness, Lucky falls in love.
A man falls for his boss' daughter and convinces his friend to pose as his father to gain approval for their marriage, resulting in a hilarious series of misunderstandings.
Subramanyam, a money-minded man, comes across Seetha, a woman living alone in the US after being abandoned by her boyfriend. Subsequently, he decides to help her after seeing her plight.

With the semblance of leading a normal life, Adi struggles with the loss of his wife, Nidhi. However, Sihi, a charming young woman, enters as a glimmer of hope when she commits to helping Adi.
A sinister man tries to defame the village landlord and create trouble for the village. However, the landlord is determined to stand tough against all the allegations.
A secretive advisor to the wealthy faces a crisis when his past catches up, risking everything he has built and forcing him to confront long-buried secrets.
Manasa falls in love with Jai after he helps her and manages to win the hearts of her family with his good deeds. However, she is unaware that he belongs to a rival family.
A man returns to India for his sister's engagement ceremony but discovers that something terrible has happened to her. On his quest for the truth, he uncovers a series of crimes against women.

Kush reluctantly marries Khushi. However, things take a drastic turn when they both start getting to know each other and uncover the lies they fed one another.
Veerabhadra, who loves his sister very much, gets her married to a nice man. However, when Veerabhadra's close friend is killed, he decides to wipe out anti-social elements in the city.
After a villager secures a marriage alliance with a city boy for his only daughter, he prepares to offer a sacrifice to the gods. However, things go awry during the ceremony.
Jagan, a local travel guide, falls in love with Radha, a tourist who visits his city. Though she leaves without saying goodbye, fate conspires to bring them together again.

When a vicious villain sets out to claim nine sacred books that hold the secret to immortality, the guardian of the ninth book ties a happy-go-lucky orphan's destiny to the quest to protect them.
After falling in love with Suchitra, Appu must go against the odds to win her over and marry her despite her father's disapproval of him.
Puttaraju and Sevanthi fall in love with each other. Sevanthi's father puts forth a condition for their marriage which Puttaraju must fulfil.
Manu, a kick-boxer must train and win an upcoming tournament to fulfill his mother's wishes and to become the best in the world.
A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.
A special agent investigates a murder committed by a masked group of serial killers. However, a tangled maze of clues soon leads him to the drug kingpin of Chennai.

programs.showName: Marakkar: Lion of the Arabian Sea
programs.description: Kunjali Marakkar IV, a fearless naval commander, rises against Portuguese tyranny. With courage and cunning, he leads a legendary resistance, defending his people in a thunderous clash of empires.
A man is pulled into a plot to assassinate a chief minister at a political rally. However, he soon realises that he is trapped in a time loop with a police officer.
A businessman returns to his homeland to reconcile with his friend. Soon, upon learning of his friend's plight, he becomes a crusader for the farmers in the village.
Ganesh, Diganth and Kitty arrive in Mugilupete to stay at Diganth's grandfather's farmhouse. However, there Ganesh falls in love with Sowmya, a widow who stays with her in-laws, Kodandaram and Padma.

Shivalinga, a poor laborer, fails to earn enough money to save his mother's life. Later, he rescues a kidnapped girl and, aiming to fund her education, joins the underworld, leading to chaotic events.
An upright police officer is up against a conniving group of criminals. So, he devises a series of unconventional methods, in order to put them behind bars.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
Three cousins, Divya, Krishnan and Arjuna, share a close bond and decide to move to Bangalore to fulfil their childhood dreams. There, they face challenges that will change their lives forever.
An intelligent and ambitious youngster arrives in Mumbai and becomes a mafia don, but one day, things take turn when he falls in love with a cop's daughter.
A writer visits his friend's village after he learns about his disappearance. On visiting the place, he discovers that the latter was murdered.
The wife of one of two rival dons sends her son to a distant land to shield him from their relentless feud. However, the son, raised as an orphan, eventually returns to the brutal world of violence.
Param, a wealthy young man, becomes romantically attached to Deepa. He soon learns that his friend Sanvi loves him and attempts to mend their relationship.
When a taxi driver begins to experience various eerie events in his vehicle, he strives to uncover the truth behind the mysterious occurrences.
A bountiful and helpful boy falls in love with a musician without knowing the fact that a rich spoilt brat is also planning to woo her.
